q1_issues.issue: The matrix predication "The world feels warmer" is entirely absent — sk_world_1 is typed and then never predicated of, so nothing records the warmth, the comparison, or the "feels" hedge.
"with friends nearby" is a circumstance the matrix claim is conditioned on, not an assertion, yet (GroupOf sk_friends_1 friend) existentially asserts that such friends exist.
The distribution rule asserts at strength 1.0 that every member of that group is nearby — again asserting adjunct content the sentence only conditions on.

q2_gaps: subject-experience copular verb "feel" with a predicative adjective ("the world feels warmer") — copular clauses are defined as "is a/an N" / "is ADJ", and only seem/appear are routed (to the epistemic operators)
bare comparative with no stated standard ("warmer", no "than" phrase) — More and MoreBy both require two compared arguments
absolute "with NP + predicate" adjunct expressing a circumstance/condition ("with friends nearby") — the "with"-phrase split given is only CoAgent vs Instrument
notes: Everything emitted belongs to the adjunct while the clause the sentence actually asserts is missing, so the record is inverted. Even granting that the standard-less comparative has no licensed encoding, dropping the whole matrix state rather than only the degree is a separate loss.
